newsitem.title: JAPAN: BT, MCI seek joint projects with KDD in Asia.
newsitem.headline: BT, MCI seek joint projects with KDD in Asia.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) and MCI Communications Corp have asked Japan's international carrier KDD to join them in joint telecoms projects in Asia, a KDD spokesman said on Wednesday.
BT president Peter Bonfield and MCI's chief executive officer Gerald Taylor met Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co president Tadashi Nishimoto in early July when they visited Japan, he said.
Bonfield and Taylor said their joint venture Concert wants to pursue telecoms projects jointly with KDD in countries such as China and Vietnam, the KDD spokesman said.
The spokesman quoted Nishimoto as saying KDD would cooperate when there are good projects.
KDD, which is losing market share in Japan's international phone services amid intensified competition, is stepping up its overseas investments, particularly in Asia.
